question.problem:
Find all real eigenvalues of the matrix 
$B=[\begin{aligned}-8 & 7 \\ -9 & 8\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
Let's start by writing the matrix $B-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
B-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}-8-\lambda  & 7 \\ -9 & 8-\lambda \end{aligned}].
$$

Now, let's find and solve the characteristic equation $det(B-\lambda I)=0:$

$$
\begin{aligned}det(B-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}-8-\lambda  & 7 \\ -9 & 8-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (-8-\lambda )(8-\lambda )-7\cdot (-9) & =0 \\ -64+8\lambda -8\lambda +{\lambda }^{2}+63 & =0 \\ {\lambda }^{2}-1 & =0 \\ (\lambda +1)(\lambda -1) & =0.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the eigenvalues are $\lambda =-1$ and $\lambda =1.$
